title: rhus latifolia
intro: Rhus latifolia, commonly known as the skunkbush or skunkbrush, is a shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Rhus latifolia include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and improve immune function. The bioactive constituents of Rhus latifolia include tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
